capabilities: Check grammar, spelling and punctuation with AI explanations and rewrites
Look up words offline using an ECDICT or compatible CSV dictionary
Practice sentences with real-time typing matching and grammar-role highlighting
Visualize sentence structure as Mermaid syntax trees
Track writing volume, mistake types and practice data, and save vocabulary and grammar notes
extras: The dictionary file (ecdict.csv or compatible CSV) is not bundled and must be downloaded separately from the ECDICT repository; AI features require internet and cost roughly $1-5/month in API fees, while dictionary lookup and shadowing practice work offline; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; additional docs (installation, TTS setup, migration) live in separate files.
intentEvidence: 不同于 Grammarly 等通用工具，English Learning Assistant 深度整合知识管理
problem: Learners of English normally juggle grammar checkers, dictionary apps and practice tools outside their notes, with no connection to their knowledge base.
